title: The change history of a fetched issue and its subtasks
description: Every changelog entry on the issue and on each subtask, oldest first per issue. Each issue's `changes` must hold its `total`. A file with fewer is a truncated fetch, not a quieter ticket.

key.description: The issue this file was fetched for.

readOnly.description: History is written by Jira as the issue changes, never by editing this file.

total.description: Changelog entries summed over every issue below.

issues.description: The fetched issue first, then each subtask in the parent's order.

readable.description: False when the account cannot read this issue. `changes` is then empty and says nothing about the issue.

total.description: The count Jira reported for this issue's changelog.

changes.description: Oldest first. One entry per edit; one edit can change several fields.

from.description: The display value Jira's History tab shows, or the raw id when Jira gives no display value.
